name: Berza.ba
tagline: Objavi teret, prevoznici ti šalju ponude
description: Online berza transporta robe u BiH. Objaviš šta treba prevesti, od paketa do namještaja i vozila, a vozači i prevoznici se nadmeću ponudama. Uporediš cijene, ocjene i profile i izabereš najbolju.
audience: Ljudi koji šalju robu i prevoznici

en.tagline: Post a load and let carriers send you offers
en.description: An online freight marketplace for Bosnia and Herzegovina. Post what needs moving, from parcels to furniture and vehicles, and drivers bid for the job. Compare prices, ratings and profiles, then pick the best offer.
